source.name: Interfax — Kola Mining Company says production chain operating normally after fire

claims.summary: Interfax reported the company’s Sept. 15, 2022 statement that its platinum-group production chain was operating normally after the fire. This is a dated, unverified Russian operator claim about the chain generally; it does not establish that the affected cobalt-production department had resumed or that the facility is operating now. Canonical operation remains unknown.

source.name: Interfax — Boiler-house accident in Klimovsk heat-outage update

claims.claimant: Press service of the Governor and Government of Moscow Oblast
claims.summary: Interfax’s Jan. 6 indexed report says the Moscow Oblast Governor and Government press service reported that a reserve boiler had been started and another pressurized after the Jan. 4 Klimovsk boiler-house accident. This is a dated, unverified Russian official claim about limited heat-service recovery; it does not establish full restoration or present operation. Canonical facility status remains unknown.
